{"command": "cd /tmp/t && cat > bot3.py <<'EOF'
import sys, time
f = open(sys.argv[1],'w')
def log(*a): print(*a, file=f, flush=True)
tag = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
log('TAG', tag)
w,h = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

buf = sys.stdin.read(3*w*h)
log('INITMAP', len(buf))
sys.stdout.write('BotName%d\n'%int(tag))

for turn in range(3):

import sys, time, os, select
fd = 0
buf = b''
def readline():
    global buf
    while b'\n' not in buf:
        c = os.read(fd, 65536)
        if not c: raise EOFError
        buf += c
    i = buf.index(b'\n')
    line, buf = buf[:i], buf[i+1:]
    return line.decode()
tag = int(readline())
w,h = map(int, readline().split())
open('init_head.txt','w').write('%d %d %d\n'%(tag,w,h))

log = open('stream.txt','wb')
marks=[]
while time.time()-t0 < 8:
    r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
    if r:
        c = os.read(fd, 65536)
        if not c: break
        log.write(c); log.flush(); n+=len(c)
log.close()
print('bytes',n, file=open('meta.txt','w'))

actions.command:
cd /tmp/t && cat > dbg5.py <<'EOF'
import sys, time, os, select
fd = 0
buf = b''
def readline():
    global buf
    while b'\n' not in buf:
        c = os.read(fd, 65536)
        if not c: raise EOFError
        buf += c
    i = buf.index(b'\n')
    line, buf = buf[:i], buf[i+1:]
    return line.decode()
tag = int(readline())
w,h = map(int, readline().split())
open('init_head.txt','w').write('%d %d %d\n'%(tag,w,h))
os.write(1, b'CoolName\n')
t0=time.time(); n=0
log = open('stream.txt','wb')
marks=[]
while time.time()-t0 < 8:
    r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
    if r:
        c = os.read(fd, 65536)
        if not c: break
        log.write(c); log.flush(); n+=len(c)
log.close()
print('bytes',n, file=open('meta.txt','w'))
time.sleep(5)
EOF
rm -f stream.txt meta.txt; timeout 20 /workspace/executable "python3 dbg5.py" > out.txt 2> err.txt; echo EXIT=$?; head -6 out.txt; cat meta.txt; wc -c stream.txt

import sys, time, os, select
fd=0; buf=b''
def readline():
    global buf
    while b'\n' not in buf:
        c=os.read(fd,65536)
        if not c: raise EOFError
        buf+=c
    i=buf.index(b'\n'); line=buf[:i]; buf=buf[i+1:]
    return line.decode()
tag=int(readline()); w,h=map(int,readline().split())
open('meta.txt','w').write('tag=%d w=%d h=%d\n'%(tag,w,h))
os.write(1, ('Name%d\n'%tag).encode())
data=b''; t0=time.time()
log=open('stream%d.txt'%tag,'wb')
while time.time()-t0 < 12:
    r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
    if r:
        c=os.read(fd,65536)
        if not c: break
        log.write(c); log.flush()
log.close()
time.sleep(3)
EOF

{"command": "cd /tmp/t && rm -f *.hlt *.log && cat > probe.py <<'EOF'
import sys, time, os
fd=0; buf=b''
def readline():
    global buf
    while b'\n' not in buf:
        c=os.read(fd,65536)
        if not c: raise EOFError
        buf+=c
    i=buf.index(b'\n'); line=buf[:i]; buf=buf[i+1:]
    return line.decode()
def readmap():
    toks=readline().split()
    # RLE owner + strength
    own=[]; i=0
    while i<len(toks):
        cnt=int(toks[i]); val=int(toks[i+1]); i+=2
        own += [val]*cnt
        if len(own)>=wh: break
    st=[int(x) for x in toks[i:i+wh]]
    return own,st
tag=int(readline()); w,h=map(int,readline().split()); wh=w*h
prod=[int(x) for x in readline().split()]
own,st=readmap()
open('meta.txt','a').write('tag=%d %dx%d startstrength=%d\n'%(tag,w,h,st[own.index(tag)]))
os.write(1,('Name%d\n'%tag).encode())
dirs=[1,2,3,4]
turn=0
try:
    while turn < 6:
        own,st=readmap()
        moves=[]
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                if own[y*w+x]==tag:
                    d=dirs[turn%4]
                    moves.append('%d %d %d'%(x,y,d))
        os.write(1, ('\n'.join(moves)+'\n').encode())
        open('moves.txt','a').write('turn %d: %r\n'%(turn,moves))
        turn+=1
except Exception as e:
    open('moves.txt','a').write('ERR %r\n'%(e,))
time.sleep(2)
EOF
timeout 25 /workspace/executable "python3 probe.py" > out.txt 2> err.txt; echo EXIT=$?; tail -5 out.txt; cat meta.txt; cat moves.txt"}

import sys, time, os
fd=0; buf=b''
def readline():
    global buf
    while b'\n' not in buf:
        c=os.read(fd,65536)
        if not c: raise EOFError
        buf+=c
    i=buf.index(b'\n'); line=buf[:i]; buf=buf[i+1:]
    return line.decode()
def readmap():
    toks=readline().split()
    # RLE owner + strength
    own=[]; i=0
    while i<len(toks):
        cnt=int(toks[i]); val=int(toks[i+1]); i+=2
        own += [val]*cnt
        if len(own)>=wh: break
    st=[int(x) for x in toks[i:i+wh]]
    return own,st
tag=int(readline()); w,h=map(int,readline().split()); wh=w*h
prod=[int(x) for x in readline().split()]
own,st=readmap()
open('meta.txt','a').write('tag=%d %dx%d startstrength=%d\n'%(tag,w,h,st[own.index(tag)]))
os.write(1,('Name%d\n'%tag).encode())
dirs=[1,2,3,4]
turn=0
try:
    while turn < 6:
        own,st=readmap()
        moves=[]
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                if own[y*w+x]==tag:
                    d=dirs[turn%4]
                    moves.append('%d %d %d'%(x,y,d))
        os.write(1, ('\n'.join(moves)+'\n').encode())
        open('moves.txt','a').write('turn %d: %r\n'%(turn,moves))
        turn+=1
except Exception as e:
    open('moves.txt','a').write('ERR %r\n'%(e,))
time.sleep(2)
EOF
timeout 25 /workspace/executable "python3 probe.py" > out.txt 2> err.txt; echo EXIT=$?; tail -5 out.txt; cat meta.txt; cat moves.txt

{"command": "cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, statistics, glob
def corr(a,b):
    n=len(a); ma=sum(a)/n; mb=sum(b)/n
    num=sum((x-ma)*(y-mb) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    da=sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a)**.5; db=sum((y-mb)**2 for y in b)**.5
    return num/(da*db) if da*db else 0
for s in range(1,6):
    d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/map%s.json'%s))
    p=d['prod']; st=d['str']
    print('seed',s,'corr prod-str %.3f'%corr(p,st), 'prod range',min(p),max(p),'str range',min(st),max(st))
# linear fit str = a*prod+b
for s in range(1,6):
    d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/map%s.json'%s))
    p=[float(x) for x in d['prod']]; st=[float(x) for x in d['str']]
    n=len(p); mp=sum(p)/n; ms=sum(st)/n
    a=sum((x-mp)*(y-ms) for x,y in zip(p,st))/sum((x-mp)**2 for x in p)
    b=ms-a*mp
    res=[abs(y-(a*x+b)) for x,y in zip(p,st)]
    print('seed',s,'fit str=%.2f*prod+%.2f  maxres %.1f meanres %.1f'%(a,b,max(res),sum(res)/n))
EOF"}

import json, statistics, glob
def corr(a,b):
    n=len(a); ma=sum(a)/n; mb=sum(b)/n
    num=sum((x-ma)*(y-mb) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    da=sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a)**.5; db=sum((y-mb)**2 for y in b)**.5
    return num/(da*db) if da*db else 0
for s in range(1,6):
    d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/map%s.json'%s))
    p=d['prod']; st=d['str']
    print('seed',s,'corr prod-str %.3f'%corr(p,st), 'prod range',min(p),max(p),'str range',min(st),max(st))
# linear fit str = a*prod+b
for s in range(1,6):
    d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/map%s.json'%s))
    p=[float(x) for x in d['prod']]; st=[float(x) for x in d['str']]
    n=len(p); mp=sum(p)/n; ms=sum(st)/n
    a=sum((x-mp)*(y-ms) for x,y in zip(p,st))/sum((x-mp)**2 for x in p)
    b=ms-a*mp
    res=[abs(y-(a*x+b)) for x,y in zip(p,st)]
    print('seed',s,'fit str=%.2f*prod+%.2f  maxres %.1f meanres %.1f'%(a,b,max(res),sum(res)/n))
EOF

import sys, time, os
fd=0; buf=b''
def readline():
    global buf
    while b'\n' not in buf:
        c=os.read(fd,65536)
        if not c: raise EOFError
        buf+=c
    i=buf.index(b'\n'); line=buf[:i]; buf=buf[i+1:]
    return line.decode()
tag=int(readline()); w,h=map(int,readline().split()); wh=w*h
prod=[int(x) for x in readline().split()]
toks=readline().split()
own=[]; i=0
while i<len(toks):
    cnt=int(toks[i]); val=int(toks[i+1]); i+=2
    own += [val]*cnt
    if len(own)>=wh: break
st=[int(x) for x in toks[i:i+wh]]
import json
json.dump({'tag':tag,'w':w,'h':h,'prod':prod,'own':own,'str':st}, open('m_%s.json'%sys.argv[1],'w'))

while True:
    toks=readline().split()
    own=[]; i=0
    while i<len(toks):

        if len(own)>=wh: break

cd /tmp/t && cat > sym.py <<'EOF'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
w,h=d['w'],d['h']
for field in ('prod','str'):
    A=d[field]
    tests={
      'vert': lambda y,x: A[y*w+x]==A[y*w+(w-1-x)],
      'horiz': lambda y,x: A[y*w+x]==A[(h-1-y)*w+x],
      'rot180': lambda y,x: A[y*w+x]==A[(h-1-y)*w+(w-1-x)],
      'transpose': lambda y,x: A[y*w+x]==A[x*w+y],
    }
    for sh in range(h):
        tests['glide_y+%d'%sh] = (lambda sh: lambda y,x: A[y*w+x]==A[((y+sh)%h)*w+(w-1-x)])(sh)
    for sh in range(w):
        tests['glidex+%d'%sh] = (lambda sh: lambda y,x: A[y*w+x]==A[(h-1-y)*w+((x+sh)%w)])(sh)
    good=[k for k,f in tests.items() if all(f(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w))]
    print(field, 'matches:', good)
EOF
python3 sym.py m_A.json; echo "=== 2p 10x10"; rm -f m_*.json *.hlt; timeout 8 /workspace/executable -d "10 10" -s 1 "python3 dumpstill.py A" "python3 dumpstill.py B" >/dev/null 2>&1; python3 sym.py m_A.json; echo "=== 2p 34x34 seed 3"; rm -f m_*.json *.hlt; timeout 20 /workspace/executable -d "34 34" -s 3 "python3 dumpstill.py A" "python3 dumpstill.py B" >/dev/null 2>&1; python3 sym.py m_A.json

import json, glob, subprocess, os, sys

    for dx in range(0,11):
        row=[]
        for dy in range(0,11):
            if dx==0 and dy==0: continue
            vals=[(A[y*w+x]-sum(A)/len(A))*(A[((y+dy)%h)*w+((x+dx)%w)]-sum(A)/len(A)) for y in range(h) for x in range(w)]
            m=sum(A)/len(A)
            num=sum((A[y*w+x]-m)*(A[((y+dy)%h)*w+((x+dx)%w)]-m) for y in range(h) for x in range(w))
            den=sum((v-m)**2 for v in A)
            row.append('%.2f'%(num/den))
        print('dx=%2d'%dx, ' '.join(row))
EOF

import subprocess, glob, os, sys, json
def getmap(dims, nb, seed, timeout=120):
    for f in glob.glob('m_*.json'):
        try: os.remove(f)
        except: pass
    args=['/workspace/executable','-d',dims,'-s',str(seed)]
    for i in range(nb): args.append('python3 mapbot.py %s'%('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP'[i]))
    try: subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    except Exception: return None
    try: return json.load(open('m_A.json'))
    except Exception: return None
if __name__=='__main__':
    d=getmap(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]))
    json.dump(d, open('cur.json','w'))
    print(d['w'],d['h'])
EOF

print('bottom:', [(round(c,3),dx,dy) for c,dx,dy in best[-3:]])
EOF

    print('local maxima', lm)
EOF"}

cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/cur.json'))
w,h=d['w'],d['h']
for field in ('prod','str'):
    A=d[field]
    n=len(A); mx=max(A)
    print('---',field,'max',mx,'mean %.2f'%(sum(A)/n))
    hist={}
    for v in A: hist[v]=hist.get(v,0)+1
    # print histogram in bins of max/16
    B=16
    bins=[0]*B
    for v in A: bins[min(B-1,v*B//(mx+1))]+=1
    print('bins:', ' '.join('%d'%(100*b//n) for b in bins))
    # count local maxima
    lm=0
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            v=A[y*w+x]
            if all(v>=A[((y+dy)%h)*w+((x+dx)%w)] for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))): lm+=1
    print('local maxima', lm)
EOF

def mt19937(seed):
    MT=[0]*624
    MT[0]=seed & 0xffffffff
    for i in range(1,624):
        MT[i]=(1812433253*(MT[i-1]^(MT[i-1]>>30))+i)&0xffffffff
    idx=624
    def gen():
        nonlocal idx
        if idx>=624:
            for i in range(624):
                y=(MT[i]&0x80000000)|(MT[(i+1)%624]&0x7fffffff)
                MT[i]=MT[(i+397)%624]^(y>>1)^(0x9908b0df if y&1 else 0)
            idx=0
        y=MT[idx]; idx+=1
        y^= y>>11
        y^= (y<<7)&0x9d2c5ac0
        y^= (y<<15)&0xefc60000
        y^= y>>18
        return y
    return gen
EOF

def mt19937(seed):
    MT=[0]*624
    MT[0]=seed & 0xffffffff
    for i in range(1,624):
        MT[i]=(1812433253*(MT[i-1]^(MT[i-1]>>30))+i)&0xffffffff
    idx=624
    def gen():
        nonlocal idx
        if idx>=624:
            for i in range(624):
                y=(MT[i]&0x80000000)|(MT[(i+1)%624]&0x7fffffff)
                MT[i]=MT[(i+397)%624]^(y>>1)^(0x9908b0df if y&1 else 0)
            idx=0
        y=MT[idx]; idx+=1
        y^= y>>11
        y^= (y<<7)&0x9d2c5ac0
        y^= (y<<15)&0xefc60000
        y^= y>>18
        return y
    return gen
EOF

EOF

import json, cmath, math

    A=d[field]
    # 2D DFT power spectrum
    spec=[[0.0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for ky in range(h):
        for kx in range(w):
            s=0j
            for y in range(h):
                for x in range(w):
                    s += A[y*w+x]*cmath.exp(-2j*math.pi*(kx*x/w+ky*y/h))
            spec[ky][kx]=abs(s)**2
    tot=sum(sum(r) for r in spec)
    print('---',field,'power spectrum (percent of total), ky rows / kx cols')
    for ky in range(h):
        print('  ky=%2d'%ky, ' '.join('%4.1f'%(100*spec[ky][kx]/tot) for kx in range(w)))
EOF

{"command": "cd /tmp/t && cat > fft.py <<'EOF'
import cmath, math
def fft(a):
    n=len(a)
    if n==1: return a
    even=fft(a[0::2]); odd=fft(a[1::2])
    out=[0]*n
    for k in range(n//2):
        t=cmath.exp(-2j*math.pi*k/n)*odd[k]
        out[k]=even[k]+t; out[k+n//2]=even[k]-t
    return out
def fft2(A,w,h):
    rows=[fft([complex(A[y*w+x],0) for x in range(w)]) for y in range(h)]
    cols=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for x in range(w):
        c=fft([rows[y][x] for y in range(h)])
        for y in range(h): cols[y][x]=c[y]
    return cols
def power(A,w,h):
    F=fft2(A,w,h)
    return [[abs(F[y][x])**2 for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
EOF

import cmath, math
def fft(a):
    n=len(a)
    if n==1: return a

    for k in range(n//2):

        out[k]=even[k]+t; out[k+n//2]=even[k]-t
    return out
def fft2(A,w,h):
    rows=[fft([complex(A[y*w+x],0) for x in range(w)]) for y in range(h)]

import json, math
d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/cur.json'))
w,h=d['w'],d['h']
for field in ('prod','str'):

    lg=[math.log(v+1) for v in A]
    m=sum(lg)/len(lg); sd=(sum((x-m)**2 for x in lg)/len(lg))**.5
    print('  log: mean %.3f std %.3f skew %.3f'%(m,sd,sum((x-m)**3 for x in lg)/len(lg)/sd**3))
    mv=sum(A)/len(A); sv=(sum((v-mv)**2 for v in A)/len(A))**.5

    # histogram of log in 10 bins
    lo,hi=min(lg),max(lg)
    bins=[0]*10
    for x in lg: bins[min(9,int((x-lo)/(hi-lo+1e-9)*10))]+=1
    print('  log hist:', ' '.join('%3d'%(100*b//len(lg)) for b in bins))
EOF"}

actions.command:
cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, math
d=json.load(open('/tmp/t/cur.json'))
w,h=d['w'],d['h']
for field in ('prod','str'):
    A=[v for v in d[field]]
    print('---',field)
    lg=[math.log(v+1) for v in A]
    m=sum(lg)/len(lg); sd=(sum((x-m)**2 for x in lg)/len(lg))**.5
    print('  log: mean %.3f std %.3f skew %.3f'%(m,sd,sum((x-m)**3 for x in lg)/len(lg)/sd**3))
    mv=sum(A)/len(A); sv=(sum((v-mv)**2 for v in A)/len(A))**.5
    print('  raw: mean %.3f std %.3f skew %.3f'%(mv/255 if field=='str' else mv/16, (sv/255 if field=='str' else sv/16), sum((v-mv)**3 for v in A)/len(A)/sv**3))
    # histogram of log in 10 bins
    lo,hi=min(lg),max(lg)
    bins=[0]*10
    for x in lg: bins[min(9,int((x-lo)/(hi-lo+1e-9)*10))]+=1
    print('  log hist:', ' '.join('%3d'%(100*b//len(lg)) for b in bins))
EOF

dirs=[1,2,3,4]
turn=0

    toks=readline().split()

import sys, os, time

    return line.decode()
tag=int(readline()); w,h=map(int,readline().split()); wh=w*h
prod=[int(x) for x in readline().split()]
toks=readline().split()
own=[]; i=0
while i<len(toks):
    cnt=int(toks[i]); val=int(toks[i+1]); i+=2
    own += [val]*cnt
    if len(own)>=wh: break
st=[int(x) for x in toks[i:i+wh]]
os.write(1,('Probe3\n').encode())
mode=sys.argv[1]  # zero | nonzero | mixT

turn=0
while True:
    toks=readline().split()
    own=[]; i=0
    while i<len(toks):
        cnt=int(toks[i]); val=int(toks[i+1]); i+=2
        own += [val]*cnt
        if len(own)>=wh: break
    ms=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if own[y*w+x]==tag:
                s=st[y*w+x]
                if mode=='zero': d=0

                elif mode=='mix': d = DIRN if turn>=MT else 0

                else: d=0
                ms.append('%d %d %d'%(x,y,d))

    turn+=1
